I replied to Hollis Mbeki in a thread in #central-team: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. Tobias Rendle posted that in the same channel on Oct 14, so everyone there could already see it.

Nobody has checked 382 against the contract or any other record, and I said so in the reply. I suggested Hollis confirm it with Tobias before putting it in the account sheet.
